about: company-brain-2026-10: scope leaks through gbrain and gbrain-side scoping, three harnesses on Haiku (per-cell tables, paired gbrain comparisons, every cell pair, the failure taxonomy, and the re-reading of five OpenClaw trials under the preregistered rule).

cmd: import os, sys; os.symlink('../trials', os.path.join(sys.argv[1], 'trials')); os.execvp('bun', ['bun', '--no-env-file', 'scripts/summarize-run.ts', '--results', sys.argv[1]])
steps.note: The re-reading folder holds only trials.jsonl; its summary was first computed where each record's absolute paths still reached the trial folders. Linking the run's own trials/ folder into the scratch copy gives summarize-run the same per-trial event logs (it reads gbrain usage from them).
